title: T-5261 follow-up: include test_ui_kit in executable-directory asset handling
body: Additional reproduction of existing T-5261: the freshly built test_ui_kit, launched from the repository root as .tmp/build/libraries/RenderGraph/tests/test_ui_kit, could not read assets/ui/kit/number-field.rml and then segfaulted after assertions (baseline queue job cx-edpolish1:baseline-scoped-tests, exit 139). Recovery was to cd .tmp/build/libraries/RenderGraph/tests before running it; the full focused suite then passed. Extend T-5261's consolidation so every RenderGraph UI test, including test_ui_kit, gets its staged asset working directory from the target/test declaration or resolves assets independently of CWD. Tier luna: the failure is reproducible but the fix belongs in shared test wiring. Effort S: one target/test harness seam.

title: direct UI startup cache test lacks its one-shot submission witness
body: test_ui_startup_cache is a Vulkan GPU executable without a registered queued test and passes nullptr to VixenRmlRenderInterface::Init; its first texture upload throws submit one-shot. The guard needs a real RenderGraph submission callback or a registered wrapper with the correct harness.

title: material witness does not provision DISPLAY for windowed editor capture
body: The documented cx_edmat8_material_witness.py route started the editor without DISPLAY and GLFW aborted before coverageReady. The capture had to be retried with DISPLAY=:0 (and VIXEN_UI_SOURCE_DIR) through the queue; the repository's run-vixen-windowed-captures.sh contains the needed provisioning but this witness script does not.
